title: A Joomla 3 sign-in refusal (a 200 that draws the login form again) is invalid_credential, no_backend_access or mfa_required, not unreachable/no_redirect
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run`.
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: A login POST answered with a 200 Joomla 3.10 login form carrying 'Username and password do not match…' is invalid_credential at login_post, and the run's diagnostic carries username_is_email (true for an email-shaped username, false otherwise), never the username.
The same 200 with 'You do not have access to the Administrator section…' is no_backend_access; with the two factor Secret Key sentence it is mfa_required.
A German Joomla 3 refusal is read through administrator/language/de-DE/de-DE.ini.
The Joomla 3 login form with no message is invalid_credential/message_unread.
A 200 that is not Joomla's admin login form (plain page, a form outside Joomla's template, RSFirewall's Protected Area) stays unreachable/no_redirect.
evidence: Production operator alert 25/10/2026 on a Joomla 3.10.11 import: Reason: unreachable · Where: login_post/no_redirect · HTTP 200 · /administrator/index.php · Sign-in: password. Joomla 3.10.11 LoginController::login() redirects only on success; a refusal falls through to display(), a 200.
fence: loginToAdmin reads a 200 answer to the login POST for Joomla's refusal sentence only when the body is Joomla's own administrator login form; the firewall check runs first, Joomla 4+ redirect handling and WordPress are unchanged

tests: Joomla 3 answering a wrong password with a 200 is invalid_credential, with the email shape kept
Joomla 3 answering an account without administrator access with a 200 is no_backend_access
Joomla 3 answering a missing Secret Key with a 200 is mfa_required
a German Joomla 3 refusing on a 200 is read through its language file
a Joomla 3 login form again with no message to read is message_unread, not unreachable
a 200 on the login POST that is not Joomla's login form stays unreachable/no_redirect
a challenge on a non-403 answer of the sign-in is blocked_by_firewall, not a generic failure
